name: CardioRisk Inference Pipeline
description: Prediction model for cardiovascular risk evaluation. Uses deep learning classification models with an interactive Streamlit interface and Docker runtime.
snippet:
# CardioRisk AI Inference Pipeline
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class CardiacRiskClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=30):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)

name: KYC Document Verification
description: Document quality check pipeline using OpenCV and FastAPI microservices with a Flutter mobile app.
snippet:
# KYC Vision Verification Microservice
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile
import cv2
import numpy as np

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/verify-quality")
async def check_document_clarity(file: UploadFile):
    image_bytes = await file.read()
    img = cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(image_bytes, np.uint8), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    laplacian_var = cv2.Laplacian(img, cv2.CV_64F).var()
    
    is_sharp = laplacian_var > 100.0
    return {"quality_score": laplacian_var, "is_valid": is_sharp}
